info.title: jilebi API
info.description:
Programmatic API for jilebi microVMs, routes, SSH keys, nodes and billing.

Authenticate with an API key (`X-API-Key` header or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`), or with a browser session cookie. API keys carry scopes — see the `POST /api/v1/api-keys` endpoint for the full list.
